{"path":"snake_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained single-file Snake game (HTML + CSS + JavaScript). Requirements:

- Canvas-based classic Snake on a 30x30 grid, rendered on a square canvas with a visible grid.
- Snake moves continuously in one of four directions (tick-based loop, e.g. ~110ms per step, speed increases slightly as score grows).
- Snake grows by 1 segment when eating food.
- Game over when hitting a wall or the snake's own body.
- Keyboard controls: Player 1 uses Arrow keys (and optionally WASD for player 2). CPU snakes steer automatically toward food using a safe pathfinding heuristic (greedy move toward food with collision avoidance / flood-fill safety check).
- Three game modes selectable from a start menu: "Human vs Human" (both snakes keyboard-controlled, P1 arrows, P2 WASD), "CPU vs Human" (CPU snake + human snake), "CPU vs CPU" (both auto). Each mode has exactly two snakes on the shared board.
- Two snakes on the same 30x30 board, each with its own score displayed live during gameplay (score panel showing both players' scores, plus the mode name).
- Food spawning: keep at least 2 food items active on the board (one per snake) and respawn when eaten; food must never spawn on a snake body.
- Collision rules: a snake dies if it hits a wall, itself, or the other snake's body (head-on head collision kills both). When a snake dies, the other continues; the round ends when both are dead (or when a snake dies, show game over screen after a short delay). Keep it simple: when any snake dies, the game ends and the game over screen is shown with final scores and the winner.
- Start menu overlay with title, mode buttons, and control instructions.
- Game over overlay showing final scores, winner, and a message "Press SPACE (or R) to restart, ESC for menu".
- Restart with a keypress: SPACE or R restarts the current mode; ESC returns to the start menu.
- Pause with P key, shown clearly.
- Polished dark theme CSS: centered layout, neon/green snake colors, player 1 vs player 2 distinct colors, HUD with scores, clean typography, no external assets or CDN dependencies (pure vanilla JS/CSS/HTML in ONE file).
- Include a small on-canvas rendering of each snake with rounded segments, distinct head color, and food as a pulsing circle.
- Make sure all code is in one file and works when opened directly in a browser (no build step)."}

p = "snake_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html"

 "30x30 grid": ("COLS" in js and "ROWS" in js and re.search(r"(COLS|ROWS)\s*=\s*30", js) is not None),

}
